A withdrawal files beside every sibling still open under the same funder, and its cooldown is two epochs times that count, with the whole pigment escrow slashable throughout. A lone agent leaves in two epochs. A household of ten that exits together waits twenty apiece, and one that staggers still pays two, four, six, up to twenty as the count falls, so the last alias meets the zenith of the curve and the household's idle capital-time reaches k squared times the base. Splitting the batch hides nothing, because the echo of the funder stays on the record.
